data.body: Landed: Gerrit 3189 patch set 1 (f13aaa04c2dd5bed5ce112b9bd760a596bebdacd) reached LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 (CI run 41268666767) with 0 unresolved comments; submitted with scripts/gerrit_safe_submit.py at that revision and merged to main unchanged as f13aaa04c2d (no server-side rebase). 8 of 9 acceptance boxes ticked. Open: the scheduled sweep (windows) criterion. The verify workflow has no Windows job, and the sweep runs only on schedule or workflow_dispatch (a GitHub write, not used). The in-flight scheduled run 41258791078 is at 757ca4852d7, before the fix; the first scheduled run containing f13aaa04c2d is the next one (about 06:45Z on 2026-11-01). Ticket stays in_progress until that run's result for tests/unit/test_review_bot.py is recorded here. Note for the close: the criterion's [non-codebase] tag sits at the end of the line, and the close precheck's tag matcher (det_operator_attested._OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE) only recognizes a leading tag, so the item is treated as an ordinary box and must be ticked with the run evidence before close.
